why: Surface materials. Indices 0–7 are Earth's ROCK_NAMES so W.rock can map without a translation table. Everything after is what the other hundred bodies are made of. tag is measured / fitted / invented for the row as a whole; why is one sentence.

materials.name: basalt
materials.why: Oceanic crust and most terrestrial lava. Earth's seafloor and Mars's plains.

materials.name: granite
materials.why: Continental crust. Lower density than basalt is why continents float.

materials.name: sediment
materials.why: Anything deposited. Erodes faster than the igneous rocks it came from.

materials.name: metamorphic
materials.why: Basement that has been cooked. Harder than the sediment it used to be.

materials.name: banded iron
materials.why: GOE leftover. Dense, red, and it does not erode on human timescales.

materials.name: impact ejecta
materials.why: Broken target rock. Weak, porous, and it blankets everything near a crater.

materials.name: coal measure
materials.why: Buried biosphere. Dark because it is carbon.

materials.name: glacial till
materials.why: Unsorted ice dump. The landform is the deposit.

materials.name: water ice
materials.cite: Wagner and Pruß 2002 IAPWS-95; triple 273.16 K, 611.657 Pa
materials.why: Ice I. Bedrock on every cold moon; a glacier on Earth; vapour below the triple point. Strength at 250 K is ~10 MPa and rises sharply as it cools — at 100 K it is stronger than granite.

materials.name: carbon dioxide ice
materials.cite: Span and Wagner 1996; CO2 triple 216.58 K, 5.185 bar
materials.why: Mars polar cap and the seasonal atmosphere. No liquid at pressures below 5.2 bar — it sublimes. Venus's lower air is the supercritical side of the same diagram.

materials.name: nitrogen ice
materials.cite: Fray and Schmitt 2009; convectK fitted after Umurhan / Trowbridge
materials.why: Sputnik Planitia. Soft enough at 40 K to convect on geologic time (Umurhan / Trowbridge). Pluto's atmosphere is the vapour in equilibrium with this ice.

materials.name: methane ice
materials.cite: Fray and Schmitt 2009 methane vapour-pressure compilation
materials.why: Solid on Pluto, liquid on Titan. Same molecule, two worlds, two phases, because Titan has 1.5 bar and 94 K and Pluto has neither.

materials.name: ammonia–water ice
materials.cite: Kargel 1992; eutectic ~176 K. boilK fitted to NH3 1-bar boil
materials.why: Eutectic around 176 K. Cryolava on moons too cold for water alone. Mix ratio is invented; the eutectic temperature is measured.

materials.name: methane clathrate
materials.cite: Sloan and Koh 2008; Q1 invariant ~272.9 K, 2.6 MPa
materials.why: Cage ice that holds methane. Q1 invariant ~272 K at 25 bar is fitted as a triple; outside that window it dissociates, not melts. Titan's interior and Earth's continental margins.

materials.name: tholin
materials.why: Photochemical goo. Titan's dunes, Pluto's Cthulhu, every reddish outer-Solar-System stain. Strength is a guess; the colour is measured.

materials.name: silicate melt
materials.why: Generic rock / magma when the engine does not know the mineral. Liquid above ~1500 K — furnace worlds.

materials.name: regolith
materials.why: Micrometeorite garden. Thermal inertia of ~50 is why the Moon swings hundreds of kelvin between noon and night.

materials.name: sulfur
materials.why: Io. Yellow when fresh, brown when heated. Liquid in a narrow window; viscosity drops by orders of magnitude across it.

materials.name: evaporite
materials.why: Halite, gypsum, the stuff karst and polygons are made of. Soluble — that is the landform.

materials.name: liquid methane
materials.why: Titan's lakes. Same triple point as methane ice; this row is the liquid so a cell can be a lake without pretending it is rock.

materials.name: supercritical CO₂
materials.why: Venus near the ground and the floor of a steam atmosphere. No phase boundary — the life grammar already lists it as a solvent.

materials.name: iron
materials.why: Core metal at the surface — Mercury's plains, a stripped Super-Earth, an iron meteorite world.

materials.name: graphite
materials.why: Carbon made rock. Dark worlds, burned atmospheres, the residue after hydrogen escapes.

materials.name: envelope
materials.why: There is no ground. Giants and sub-Neptunes. Colour is a sketch of a 1-bar deck, not a surface.
